title: Schedule proposals
intro: Propose dates for several teams at once. The teams are placed in dependency order, each with the teams placed before it as fixed dates, until the dates stop changing. Nothing changes until you accept.
teamsPlaceholder: Pick the teams to plan together
readOnly: A proposal is open, so the teams are locked — discard it first to pick other teams.
noTeamsHint: A team's manager or an administrator can run a proposal.
forbidden: Only a manager of every listed team or an administrator can propose or accept a schedule across teams
gone: A team of the proposal no longer exists — reload the page
invalid: The proposal could not be applied — propose again

facts.unsettled_one: Not settled after {{count}} pass: the teams depend on each other in a loop, so every pass moved something again. The dates shown are the last pass's — check the link warnings before you accept.
facts.unsettled_other: Not settled after {{count}} passes: the teams depend on each other in a loop, so every pass moved something again. The dates shown are the last pass's — check the link warnings before you accept.

section.loadIntro: The team's load per week after accepting the ticked moves. It only warns — nothing moves.
section.loadNone: Tick a move to see the load after accepting it.

noCapacity: Nothing could be placed: the chosen teams have no capacity after {{date}} for the milestones to place — add a capacity period first.
rescoped: The plan of the chosen teams changed since the proposal: here is a fresh one. Your selection was kept for the milestones that still move.
stale: The plan changed in the meantime — nothing was saved. Propose again.
requesting: Asking for a proposal — the teams are locked until it arrives.
noTeamsAdmin: No team to propose for yet
noTeamsAdminHint: Create a team under Teams first.
